name: Quiet Queue
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Quiet Queue adds a trustworthy focus switch to Omarchy. Start a 25- or 50-minute session, see the countdown in the bar, and return to normal notification delivery when it expires. It drives Omarchy's native Do Not Disturb, so Omarchy decides what survives: most notifications go to history, while transient and notify-send ones are dropped. Quiet Queue never reads notification contents. It turns DND off only when it owns the session, and changes nothing it can't read. State checks every 5 seconds.
